```{=html}
<section class="band band-green">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow">If you insist</p>

    <h2 class="section-title">Registry</h2>

    <p class="date-place" style="text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0.04em; font-size:1rem">
      Your being there is genuinely the whole thing &mdash; a lot of you are travelling a long
      way to stand on a lawn in upstate New York with us, and that is more than enough. But for
      anyone who has asked, we have put a registry together on Zola.
    </p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-shells">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <div class="registry-card">

      <p class="eyebrow">Registered at</p>

      <h3 class="registry-wordmark">Zola</h3>

      <hr class="stripe-rule" style="max-width:160px; margin:0 auto 2rem">

      <p style="line-height:1.8; max-width:460px; margin:0 auto 2.2rem">
        Everything lives in one place, including shipping &mdash; Zola will send gifts straight
        to us, so nothing needs to travel to the wedding.
      </p>

      <a class="btn" href="https://www.zola.com/registry/gabrielleandrileyjune19/"
         target="_blank" rel="noopener">View our registry</a>

      <!-- Zola's live embed. Renders the registry inline once it is set to
           public; until then it reads "This registry is private." -->
      <div class="zola-embed-frame">
        <a class="zola-registry-embed"
           href="https://www.zola.com/registry/gabrielleandrileyjune19/"
           data-registry-key="gabrielleandrileyjune19">Our Zola Wedding Registry</a>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-cream">
  <div class="band-narrow" style="text-align:center">

    <p class="eyebrow">A note</p>

    <p style="line-height:1.9; max-width:560px; margin:0 auto; font-size:1.02rem">
      Please do not feel any obligation here. We have been together a long time and already have
      most of what we need &mdash; the best possible gift is you on the dance floor at the
      Fontainebleau Inn on a Saturday night in June.
    </p>

    <p class="script" style="font-size:2.1rem; margin-top:2rem">Gabrielle &amp; Riley</p>

  </div>
</section>

<!-- Zola's official registry widget. It enhances the link above; if the script
     fails to load, the link still works on its own. -->
<script>
!function (e, t, n) {
  var s, a = e.getElementsByTagName(t)[0];
  e.getElementById(n) || (
    s = e.createElement(t),
    s.id = n,
    s.async = !0,
    s.src = "https://widget.zola.com/js/widget.js",
    a.parentNode.insertBefore(s, a)
  )
}(document, "script", "zola-wjs");
</script>
```
